# Kaboom

> Kaboom is a free multiplayer Bomberman remake that runs in the browser, made to be played in two clicks during a lunch break. Create a room, share the link, everyone lands in the arena. Last one standing wins. Dead players come back as vengeful ghosts who can drop trap bombs on the survivors.

Kaboom is a project by Stranix. No account, no download, no database: rooms live in memory and disappear when they empty. The interface is available in French and English.

## Gameplay

- Rooms are public or private, joined by a shareable link (`?room=CODE`); the arena size adapts to the number of players.
- Vengeful ghosts: when you die you float above the arena and can drop a trap bomb every few seconds, so nobody waits idle until the round ends.
- Sudden death: after about 55 seconds the walls close in from the edges in a spiral, keeping rounds short.
- Power-ups: extra bomb, blast range, speed.
- Three visual themes: neon terminal, retro pixel, minimal flat.
- Controls: arrow keys or WASD to move, space to drop a bomb; a touch pad and bomb button appear on mobile.

## Technical notes

- Authoritative Node.js server: it simulates the game and broadcasts the full state about 20 times per second over WebSocket; the client only renders and sends inputs.
- Open source, see the repository below.
